text:
mikaela_cs: Hey team — Galeon Systems onboarding asks for a temporary egress/region pin + QPS bump for a 2-week pilot. They want EU primary + APAC secondary, plus two CIDRs whitelisted. Can ops confirm feasibility and an auto-revoke timeline?

raj_ops: Can do but need org id, exact CIDRs, and whether this is a hard pin or soft preference. Also flag any renewal urgency?

mikaela_cs: Org: galeon-prod. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and single IP 198.51.100.42. Pilot QPS target: 5,000 sustained (current default 500). Request temp window ~ 2026-03-25 -> 2026-04-08 with auto-revoke on 04-08. Renewal in ~6 weeks so this demo is high impact.

luis_sre: Ok. We can provision a provisional QPS cap of 5k on a dedicated route; recommend ramp 2k -> 5k over 24h to avoid cold-cache storms. For regions: pin primary eu-west-1, secondary ap-northeast-1. Any compliance/logging constraints?

tom_security: No special regs called out by the customer. They do request reduced retention for request bodies during the pilot — please add mask/pseudonymize flag. They already supplied mTLS certs in onboarding bundle.

emma_sales: Heads-up: renewal is high priority. If we can keep p95 < 150ms during the demo they'll sign. I want a 60m run-through with their SRE — can we target Tue 9am PT?

infra-bot: route-change-request received: req-987654. Current status: pending approval.

raj_ops: I'll open OPS ticket OPS-4521 and attach the CIDRs and org. Planning to apply allowlist + region pin and set the autoscale profile to "pilot-5k". @luis_sre can you review the autoscale policy and confirm safe CPU/GPU margins?

luis_sre: Reviewing now. Proposed config snippet below (for ops ticket):

```
customer_id: galeon-prod
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 198.51.100.42/32
region_pins:
  primary: eu-west-1
  secondary: ap-northeast-1
qps_cap: 5000
ramp: { start: 2000, target: 5000, window_hours: 24 }
auto_revoke: 2026-04-08T00:00:00Z
log_retention_override: minimal
```

Approved from SRE side — schedule apply at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z UTC. We'll monitor token-level latency and error spikes; set temporary alerting for >2% 5xx or p95 >200ms.

deploy-bot: OPS-4521: policy-change queued. Pending preflight checks.

raj_ops: Preflight passed. Applying allowlist and pins now, will post back when done.

deploy-bot: policy-change applied to galeon-prod: allowlist entries added (203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.42), region pins set (eu-west-1 primary, ap-northeast-1 secondary), qps_cap=5000 with ramp. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-04-08T00:00:00Z. Ticket OPS-4521 updated.

mikaela_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll confirm time with Galeon SRE for Tue 9am PT and flag renewal team. Will update the ticket if they want any extra logging off.
